text: Leo is 6 and he's autistic. He loves dinosaurs and anything with wheels. Loud music in big rooms is really hard for him, he'll cover his ears and drop to the floor. He used to be allergic to eggs but he outgrew it last year, so snacks are fine now. The important thing: his dad is NOT allowed to pick him up, there's a court order, only me (Sara) or his grandma Ruth. When he's overwhelmed he bolts for the nearest door, so please keep an eye on the exits.
